Subject: Proposed shift: Q4 integration demo (RSA overlap)

Hi Sarah —

Quick heads up: I realized I’ll be at RSA the week of Nov 15–19 and that overlaps with the window we discussed for the Q4 integration demo. My travel is fairly fixed, but we want to keep momentum on the integration work. Two options from our side:

1) Move the live demo earlier (we can do Nov 10 or Nov 12)
2) Keep the current week and have Soojin run the live walkthrough; I’ll join remotely for the Q&A when possible

I’ve attached a small .ics with the proposed alternative times (proposed-times.ics) — can you indicate which of the above you prefer and your team’s availability? If neither works, tell us a couple of windows and we’ll prioritize.

Agenda we plan to cover (high level):
- 20 min: integration walkthrough (API, auth, rate limits)
- 20 min: sample data import + mapping
- 10 min: questions, next steps & mutual action items

If Nov 10 or 12 works for you, we can lock it today. If you prefer Soojin to lead, she’s looped and happy to present.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
